title: 2_6_Psych_Project_Subject_Paige

question_options.question: How would you rate this episode?
Did you expect Owen to kiss Paige?
Are you excited for the next episode?

nodes.text: Owen and Paige dance seamlessly around the floor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is... Oddly natural.
The music fades, and Owen is left holding Paige. She stares up at him for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yes?
Paige pulls away, and Owen lets her go.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That was... Ahem... Very good. For a first-timer.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Brilliant! Never stop! New song!
The instructor snaps his fingers, and a new song plays.
After an hour of dancing, the instructor wipes tears from his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: In all my days, I never thought I would see such natural talent. You must return.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Good. And now that you've promised to come back, I don't care about you. Get out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. Come on. I need to do a little bit of shopping before we meet my dad for dinner.
Paige's car swings up to the curb.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And why is that so hard to believe?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, if you practice something, it implies that you want to get better at it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And that makes you feel... I don't know... More human? Less like a rich girl cartoon.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If I were a cartoon, I bet you I'd be really hot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aaaaand... Back to a cartoon.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You just always seem so... Empty and fake.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh... I didn't mean that to sound so harsh. I meant it as a compliment, I swear!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, awesome! Let me compliment `you` the same way! You look like a dopey giraffe!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, awesome! Let me compliment [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] the same way! You look like a dopey giraffe!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, I just meant that it was refreshing to know that you weren't as fake as I thought.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So only a little bit fake?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ummm... I'll stop talking now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Good move.
Owen immediately steps on Paige's toes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ow! Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry...
He spins her around, but her momentum is carrying her in the opposite direction!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, hello? Clockwise! `Clockwise!` Do poor people not have clocks?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, hello? Clockwise! [color=#3b78e2][i]Clockwise![/i][/color] Do poor people not have clocks?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I forgot, okay! All my clocks are digital!

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Stop! Stop! Stop!

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: How can I put this delicately?
The instructor points his finger at all the other dancers.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Good! Good! Good! Good! Good! Good! Good!
He points to Owen and Paige...

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Horrible! Whatever your names are, get out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I'm Paige. I come here all the time. You just called me by my name when I walked in.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: When you dance like you do, baby, you don't have a name.
Paige trudges out of the studio, Owen following.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks a lot!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I told you I don't dance!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you had just shut up like I told you to, you wouldn't have had to dance in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I'm sorry, I didn't expect to be thrusted into a dance or die situation.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grrr! I `hate` this project!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grrr! I [color=#3b78e2][i]hate[/i][/color] this project!

nodes.text: Paige makes a beeline for a nearby clothing store.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: To let off some steam before we meet my dad for dinner!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Your friends don't seem very nice.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They can be. But they can also be a vicious pack of dogs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Vicious dogs... Wearing `way` too much perfume.
nodes.text_bbcode: Vicious dogs... Wearing [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too much perfume.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee. Thanks for trying to save me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It didn't seem fair for them to gang up on you like that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I didn't realized it was up to you to protect me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...
Paige's phone beeps, and she looks at it, frowning.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just a slight change in plans for dinner. Nothing that concerns you.
They walk through the mall, an awkward silence between them. Owen finally breaks it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... I assume we're here so you can pick up a new wig.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not even going to react to that. Actually, I'm barely shopping at all today. I have a dance class.
Paige leads Owen into a dance studio, where an instructor struts around critiquing dancers on the dance floor. He stops when he sees Paige.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Paige! Angel! How good of you to come! We're just starting the waltz!
Paige turns to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Have a seat. Don't touch anything. Don't say anything. Don't breathe on anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And if anyone asks, you don't know me. The last thing I want is someone suspecting we came together.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, your people skills are really improving.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean it. Go away. Now!
The dance instructor flitters over, his face beaming.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: What's this? Young love blossoming in my studio?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Love? Please. I just ate.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And `I` just barf--
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] just barf--

nodes.text: Paige glares at him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Just... Was also grossed out.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: You're perfect partners for the waltz!

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Two peas in a pod! Two pigs in a blanket! Two yams in a sock!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No no no. We're not yams. We're not peas. And we're `definitely` not pigs. Bad idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: No no no. We're not yams. We're not peas. And we're [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] not pigs. Bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For once, I agree with her. Really `really` bad idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: For once, I agree with her. Really [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Too late! It's decided!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't understand. It's not just because Paige is gross...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...It's a bad idea because I don't dance.
The instructor's face goes completely serious, as if hardening into stone.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Young man. Everybody. Dances.
With that, the instructor points his finger toward the ceiling. As if on cue, music begins playing from an unknown source.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: You will dance... Or you will die.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Kidding! But seriously, if you don't dance, I'll throw you out! And I'll use my claws too!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, do not embarrass me!
Paige grabs Owen's hands and positions one in her hand, the other on her shoulder.
The other dances get into position around them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All you have to do in the waltz is keep the rhythm, hold your frame, and twirl me clockwise! Got it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Begin!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, it's okay!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry. I can't just stand on the sidelines.
Owen turns to the girls.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige told you it isn't any of your business, so just drop it.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: O.M.G! Who do you think `you` are? We've known Paige for forever!
nodes.text_bbcode: O.M.G! Who do you think [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] are? We've known Paige for forever!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, that's obviously not long enough to have some courtesy.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Courtesy? My dad owns a dozen yachts... We can't afford to be courteous.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Speak for yourself, Priss.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I like this new guy, Paige! He's rough around the edges, but with the right credit card, I think he'd fix right up!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Oh, and I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Ditto.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ugh. Fine. Let's just shop, girls. Paige? Coming with?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You'll have to shop without me. I have to run some stupid errands with Owen.
The girls shrug their shoulders and leave.
The girls don't even flinch.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Are you joking?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Sorry, New Guy, but where we shop, we don't really have `sales.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, New Guy, but where we shop, we don't really have [color=#3b78e2][i]sales.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: The rich don't believe in sales, discounts, or coupons. Not that you would know.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am `so` embarrassed.
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] embarrassed.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Anyway, nice try.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: What's a coupon? Do you put it on a salad?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So, Paige, why `did` you transfer?
nodes.text_bbcode: So, Paige, why [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] you transfer?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe to get away from all your nosiness!
The girls gasp!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Come on! Paige obviously wants to be alone with her hobo friend. So let's help her out.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Bye!
They walk away, leaving Paige.
Just then the door flings open, and $ZOE comes rushing in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am so so `so` sorry I'm late, Taylor! I was just trying to catch up on some homework, and I completely lost track of time!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am so so [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry I'm late, Taylor! I was just trying to catch up on some homework, and I completely lost track of time!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's strike one against you! Two more, and I'm giving Social Chair to Paige!
$ZOE notices Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, hi, Paige. Hi... Owen. What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Psych Project.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. I'm so shocked over here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's your reasoning, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well... $ZOE is nice, good-hearted, and responsible.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See? He's way into her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Relax. I get it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just feel like if she said she'd be here, she'll be here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I agree. She may be too nice at times, but her word is strong... It's like dwarf armor.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Dwarf armor? When did you become... Like this?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You mean, a super awesome President who has control over your future?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm surprised...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And impressed!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Cold-blooded, Owen. I can admire that. Want to explain yourself?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If she said she'd be here, she should be here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have to apologize for `him.` He's here because of this eye-roll of a project we have to do for Psych. It's all about what happens when rich people hang out with peasants.
nodes.text_bbcode: I have to apologize for [color=#3b78e2][i]him.[/i][/color] He's here because of this eye-roll of a project we have to do for Psych. It's all about what happens when rich people hang out with peasants.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That is not the point of the project.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Just please try to stay in the corner there. And don't speak unless spoken to!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll speak when I want to speak!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not how this works! You're `observing` my life! I didn't say anything when I was observing yours!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not how this works! You're [color=#3b78e2][i]observing[/i][/color] my life! I didn't say anything when I was observing yours!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! You spent the entire time calling me poor and insulting my grandma's house!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How did I insult her house?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You said it looked dumpy!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See? This is what I don't get... How can facts be insulting?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? How about the `fact` that your face looks like a--
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? How about the [color=#e23b3b][i]fact[/i][/color] that your face looks like a--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ahem! Last I checked, this was `my` meeting in `my` awesome Presidential office! If anyone's going to be hurling insults, it'll be me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahem! Last I checked, this was [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] meeting in [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] awesome Presidential office! If anyone's going to be hurling insults, it'll be me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Apologize now or get out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just didn't want you to think less of me for bringing along an 'unwanted' guest.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? That's the nicest way you could phrase that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Guys! Shut up! I don't care if Owen's here...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He can't ruin the meeting anymore than $ZOE already has. I swear, that girl's got her priorities all mixed up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's like she's focused all her skill points on Dexterity while completely ignoring her Stamina!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, right... Uh, it's like she's wearing fab shoes with last year's outfit.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew. `That` I understood.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ew. [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] I understood.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know, she's probably not coming. I don't even think she cares about Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: First, she completely botched the budget... Now she's ditching your meeting. It's like she doesn't respect you at all.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow. You're so right. I guess I'll just `give you` the Social Chair position!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. You're so right. I guess I'll just [color=#3b78e2][i]give you[/i][/color] the Social Chair position!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! Who do you think you're talking to? I invented manipulation back when you were eating glue!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're only a year ahead of me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatev. What do you think, Owen? Should we wait for $ZOE to start the meeting?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're asking him?! He's, like, `in love` with $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're asking him?! He's, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]in love[/i][/color] with $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is that true?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... I'm just an impartial observer.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. Then that makes you perfect for providing an impartial opinion. So?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Last I checked, following your advice when it comes to rich girls and lessons is a bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? Do you know who you're talking to? I'm Spencer the Advice Dispenser!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought you were the Pain Dispenser.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It changes. Depends on what I'm dispensing.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, well. I appreciate the advice, but I'm going to pass.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige's presentation could completely ruin both my grade and my reputation...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Your loss... I want to see you working `twice` as hard the next time we workout!
nodes.text_bbcode: Your loss... I want to see you working [color=#e23b3b][i]twice[/i][/color] as hard the next time we workout!

nodes.text: Owen leaves.
A few minutes later, he arrives in Taylor's office. Taylor and Paige are there waiting. $ZOE is noticeably absent.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nice of you to finally show. I didn't want to have to come fetch you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And yuck! You smell. What were you doing? Playing in garbage?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sweating. It's that thing you do when you physically work at something, but I guess you wouldn't know anything about that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut up! Both of you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine. Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great idea! It's exactly the kind of petty, attention-grabbing stunt `she'd` pull!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great idea! It's exactly the kind of petty, attention-grabbing stunt [color=#e23b3b][i]she'd[/i][/color] pull!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! Yeah!
Owen throws down his stuff and stays back, lifting weights with Spencer.
A few minutes later...
The gym doors fly open!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where is he?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Showtime!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh.
Paige marches angrily up to Owen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you forget that you have somewhere to be right now?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. I just figured you deserved to be taught a lesson.
Paige gets right in Owen's face.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do I need to remind you that tomorrow `I'll` be presenting everything I've learned about you in class?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do I need to remind you that tomorrow [color=#3b78e2][i]I'll[/i][/color] be presenting everything I've learned about you in class?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And that I have the capacity to easily ruin you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How? By telling the class I don't have any servants?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Burn!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can ruin you by telling everyone how your diary says that you're in love with me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You love Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! She's making it up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You keep a diary?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Making. It. Up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You see how easily it'd be believed, don't you? And how quickly word would reach a certain girl...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I get it. I get it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Next time you try to teach me a lesson, make sure you have something to back it up with!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now, come on! I can't afford to look bad in front of Taylor!
A few minutes later, Paige and Owen step into Taylor's office. $ZOE is noticeably absent.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Glad `someone` could make it to this meeting.
nodes.text_bbcode: Glad [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color] could make it to this meeting.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry we're late, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is that what we're here for?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, what else is there?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I hate to break it to you, but football isn't coming around again for a long time, Spencer. You might want to consider something else. Something not football.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You mean... Not football?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Was my statement confusing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No. I just don't know if I'm ready for something not football.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You'll find something.
They switch places, Owen spotting Spencer as he lifts.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Man, I can't even begin to tell you how much I've been dreading today.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All day long Paige is going to be rubbing how much money she has right in my face.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Oof!` Wait... `Oof!` Are you poor, dude? `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color] Wait... [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color] Are you poor, dude? [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, my wallet's on the skinny side, but we're all poor compared to Paige. I'm just the sucker who got assigned to her.
Spencer rests for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This project seems lame, man. You should have taken Finances. I don't know what Mr. Dean is thinking.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: When he was handing out the assignment, he said that we would be surprised by what we found.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: At this point, I'd be surprised to be surprised.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That... Hurt my head. English, man, English.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There just doesn't seem to be anything more to Paige. She's completely one-dimensional... And that dimension is snobby.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It took you this long to figure that out? She's just like every rich girl...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Spoiled, stuck up, and stupid. Just like a... Like a bug in dirt.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You might want to work on a new metaphor.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And you might want to work on a new face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't even know what that means.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Neither do I. So what does she have you doing first? Watching her polish the silver?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. I think with Paige it's more like watching her ordering `someone else` to polish the silver.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. I think with Paige it's more like watching her ordering [color=#e23b3b][i]someone else[/i][/color] to polish the silver.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. Or ordering you to do it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, I'm supposed to see her in a few minutes for some meeting she has with Taylor and $ZOE about Social Chair. I'd better get going.
Owen starts to pack up his stuff to go. Spencer blocks him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa, dude, what's the rush?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like I said, the meeting starts pretty soon.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pff. If it were me, I'd make `her` come get `you.` That'll teach her a lesson about disrespecting you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Pff. If it were me, I'd make [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] come get [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] That'll teach her a lesson about disrespecting you.

nodes.text: Owen pumps the weight down to his chest and explodes back up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Grrr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Grrr![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes! Again!
He easily does a full set of reps before finally setting the barbell back on the rack.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes! That's what I'm talking about! How'd that feel?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Never forget! Sometimes you have to just seize the moment!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're not about to tell me YOLO, are you?
Spencer glares at him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why didn't I just kiss her back?

He realizes for the first time what he should have realized back then...

nodes.text: Do you want to tell me what's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nothing's wrong.

nodes.text: You're crying into a carton of ice cream.

nodes.text: What's the joke?

nodes.text: You don't have anything! You live in that tiny pathetic house with your grandma...

nodes.text: So why should I care if my parents aren't around? Why do I even care?

nodes.text: You know, I haven't told anyone this, but my parents are separated.

nodes.text: They don't do that anymore...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That phase is kinda nice.

nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But then there are these other moments where it doesn't feel like they love you at all.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For me, it was the State Championship game.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My dad kept refusing to come see me play. He was still angry at me for leaving his precious team.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But my mom didn't want to risk seeing him, so...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Neither of them came to the game, did they?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nope.
Paige scoops out another chunk of ice cream and drops it into her bowl. She hands the spoon to Owen, and he takes a bite.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, I like this side of you. The Paige who eats ice cream instead of imported yogurt, who repairs horseshoes, and who doesn't have her guard up.
Paige looks up at Owen, and her breath catches. He's unintentionally in that space that feels too close...
She leans forward...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you...?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Bull. When you left, you didn't seem to care about me at all. I'm not an idiot, you know?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know why I lied...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You were just doing what you do.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And what's that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Being considerate.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For lying to you?
Paige dabs at her eyes with a silk napkin.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No. For... For the sentiment behind the lie.

nodes.text: You're welcome.

nodes.text: Of course. Why would I expect you to come back for anything else?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Did I miss something here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No. Forget it. Just keep observing me so you can get your precious grade!
Owen storms off, rushing back through the expansive halls of Paige's mansion.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What happened back there?
He exits out the front door and finds his truck waiting for him, idling.

nodes.speaker: Owen

As he goes around his truck and opens the door, he has one very clear thought...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige is going to try and ruin me...
He drives off, dreading the next day of school...
In Psychology class the next day...

nodes.text: Ahem...

nodes.text: The first word that comes to mind when thinking of Owen is...

What's up?
We need to talk, son.

Kay and Kel burst into the room.

Kara coos from her crib in the corner.
Gaaaaa!

Unfair. Come on, Kel.
We just can't get a break in this house.
The girls leave.
They `are` right. About the Dad code. I'm guessing this is about me being home for so long.
We thought you were just homesick, son. And that was fine. But your mother and I discussed it, and we both think it's time for you to move on.
You mean, move on from $ZOE?
Horace and Cathy share a glance between each other.
You've been given an opportunity son. A scholarship that covers tuition we could never afford.
Just because it's expensive, doesn't mean it's valuable.
No, it doesn't. We know how much you care for $ZOE. We want you to be happy, and we both know how much the two of you love each other.
But your scholarship is for `a lot` of money!
Horace! Be sensitive.
I'm being sensitive, dear. I'm looking out for all the people who weren't offered scholarships to a prestigious university!
Guys, I `know` how much of an opportunity Kingston is for me, but...
Howard mulls over what he's about to say. He looks at his parents' faces and realizes he only has one course of action.
He sighs...
I didn't want to have to tell you this... But $ZOE was feeling really depressed without me.
Oh, dear.
Uh-huh.
She... She asked me to come back for a while. I couldn't say no.
Poor thing.
Well... I guess you can always make up some of the lost time...
I swear I will!
In the meantime, why don't we have $ZOE over for dinner sometime next week?
Uh... Okay. That sounds nice. Meeting adjourned?
For now...
Kay and Kel poke their heads in from the hallway.
Good meeting!
Yay! $ZOE's coming over!
Girls! What did I tell you?
Yah! Angry dad!
Run for safety!
As the girls rush back into their rooms, Horace laughs.
Ha! I can't stay mad at them!
That's because they're miniature versions of you, sweetie.
